definition: Technical and institutional activities to establish, expand, consolidate, upgrade or manage facilities that host computing, storage and network equipment. Includes new or upgraded datacenters, server rooms, modular facilities, colocation, consolidation, racks and cabling, power and cooling, fire protection, physical security, environmental monitoring, DCIM, energy efficiency, operating procedures and facility standards. Excludes general office construction, end-user devices, telecom towers and access networks, standalone electricity works not tied to a computing facility, and routine server replacement without a facility, consolidation or hosting objective. Disaster recovery is disaster_recovery unless the activity also establishes or upgrades a recovery facility.
